chart_of_accounts.note: The fallback coding menu for a US client with no synced chart of accounts. This is the SALVAGED half of the closed PR #1122, which was hand-rolling the same palette as a US-specific usAccountPalette.js module — the wrongness was real, the shape was not: it belongs in the pack as data, not in a per-country core module. Declared here because gap 7 is a live wrongness in EVERY market and leaving the US on the Singapore list while FI and GB are fixed would simply relocate it. This is pack data, not a restart of US product work.

obligations.note: NOT an assertion that the US imposes no statutory obligations — it plainly does (federal and state income tax filings, state sales-tax registration and returns, payroll filings). It is an assertion that nobody has enumerated them for this pack. The section exists so that emptiness cannot be mistaken for cleanliness: `survey: not_surveyed` reports on every statutory_watches run, whereas a bare empty list would have read as a market with nothing to watch. The US was deprioritised on 2026-07-27 (Kari) in favour of Finland and the UK in parallel; this key records the resulting gap rather than hiding it. Surveying the US is US work and is deliberately not started here.
